environment.description: Same application deployed in EKS pod (Bottlerocket AMI nodes). Pod spec includes a seccomp profile loaded from '/var/lib/kubelet/seccomp/imageproc-strict.json' that allows only: read, write, openat, close, fstat, mmap, mprotect, munmap, brk, rt_sigaction, rt_sigprocmask, ioctl, access, execve, getdents64, fcntl, lseek, futex, clone, wait4, exit_group, arch_prctl, set_tid_address, set_robust_list, prlimit64, getrandom, statx, newfstatat, pipe2, dup2, getpid, getuid, getgid, geteuid, getegid, epoll_create1, epoll_ctl, epoll_wait, socket(AF_UNIX only via BPF argument inspection), connect(AF_UNIX only). Additionally, the pod runs with a read-only root filesystem (readOnlyRootFilesystem: true) with an emptyDir volume mounted at /var/app/uploads and /tmp only. The ImageMagick policy.xml is baked into the container image at build time with: all delegate entries removed (no external program invocation via delegates.xml), MVG/MSL/SVG/PS/EPS/PDF/XPS coders disabled via <policy domain='coder' rights='none' pattern='MVG|MSL|SVG|PS|EPS|PDF|XPS|EPHEMERAL|URL|HTTPS|HTTP|FTP' />, and resource limits of 256MiB memory, 50MiB disk, 10 second time limit.

config.seccomp_profile: custom allowlist - notably blocks socket(AF_INET/AF_INET6), connect(AF_INET/AF_INET6), sendto, recvfrom, sendmsg, recvmsg for non-AF_UNIX
config.pod_security: readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, runAsNonRoot: true, allowPrivilegeEscalation: false, capabilities drop ALL
config.volumes: emptyDir at /var/app/uploads and /tmp only, no hostPath
config.imagemagick_policy: coders MVG|MSL|SVG|PS|EPS|PDF|XPS|EPHEMERAL|URL|HTTPS|HTTP|FTP set to rights='none'; all delegates removed from delegates.xml; resource limits 256MiB/50MiB/10s
config.network_policy: Calico NetworkPolicy allows egress only to cluster DNS (kube-dns:53/UDP) and internal services on port 5432 and 6379; all other egress denied
config.node_ami: Bottlerocket (immutable root, no shell utilities beyond minimal set)
